cards.title: Parameterized Queries & ORM Traps
cards.deterministic_analogy: Keep code and data strictly separated, just like passing argv slices instead of shell strings.
cards.secure_default: Use bound placeholders ($1, ?) for every dynamic SQL value; validate dynamic ORDER BY column names against a static allowlist.
cards.why_one_liner: String interpolation or raw ORM fragments let untrusted input rewrite query logic and dump or modify rows across tenants.
cards.code_snippet:
row := db.QueryRowContext(ctx,
  "SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2",
  tenantID, userID,
)

cards.title: SSRF & Private-IP Egress Blocking
cards.deterministic_analogy: Check destination IPs after DNS resolution, like verifying an address at the loading dock.
cards.secure_default: Validate URLs against an HTTPS allowlist and block loopback, link-local (169.254.169.254), and RFC1918 IPs inside the dialer.
cards.why_one_liner: Unchecked server-side fetches let attackers pivot to cloud metadata endpoints, localhost admin panels, or internal services.

cards.title: Path Traversal & Workspace Confinement
cards.deterministic_analogy: Use OS-enforced directory handles instead of string prefix checks that symlinks bypass.
cards.secure_default: Open user-supplied relative paths via os.OpenRoot (Go 1.24+) or O_NOFOLLOW plus realpath checks against a fixed base directory.
cards.why_one_liner: String checks like filepath.Clean fail against symlinks and traversal sequences, exposing host files like /etc/passwd or ~/.ssh.
cards.code_snippet:
root, err := os.OpenRoot(workspaceDir)
if err != nil { return err }
defer root.Close()
f, err := root.Open(relPath)

cards.title: Zero-.env Keyless Local Development
cards.deterministic_analogy: Inject short-lived secrets in memory at runtime, like an SSH agent instead of plaintext keys on disk.
cards.secure_default: Inject credentials at process launch with locksmith run instead of storing plaintext secrets in .env files or shell history.
cards.why_one_liner: Plaintext .env files are routinely swept into git commits, AI context windows, and compromised build scripts.
cards.code_snippet:
# Run locally without writing plaintext secrets to .env:
locksmith run -- go test ./...

cards.title: Dependency & Slopsquatting Pre-Flight Hygiene
cards.deterministic_analogy: Verify package provenance before installing, like checking a TLS certificate before sending a login.
cards.secure_default: Vet unfamiliar AI-suggested packages via argus before installing, pin exact hashes in lockfiles, and verify maintainer ownership.
cards.why_one_liner: LLMs hallucinate plausible package names that attackers register on PyPI and npm to execute malware on install.
cards.code_snippet:
# Pre-flight check before installing unfamiliar packages:
argus check npm <package-name>

cards.title: SBOM & License Provenance Hygiene
cards.deterministic_analogy: Track software ingredients automatically at build time, like labels generated directly from the recipe.
cards.secure_default: Generate a CycloneDX SBOM and verify license compatibility automatically in local release checks using bomhound.
cards.why_one_liner: Untracked transitive dependencies hide vulnerable libraries and copyleft obligations until right before launch.
cards.code_snippet:
# Generate CycloneDX SBOM and verify licenses locally:
bomhound scan --format cyclonedx --out sbom.json .
